rules.summary: forbid waste rule in C-LOOP-1; recoverable > $2.00, then pause_with_checkpoint

files.source:
version: 1
rules:
  - id: allow-all
    kind: permit
    when: {}
  - id: stop-loops
    kind: forbid
    when:
      waste_rule: { in: ["C-LOOP-1"] }
      recoverable_usd: { gt: "2.00" }
    action: pause_with_checkpoint
